title: Accept identical embedded compositor copies while refusing distinct images
body:
Integration40042897373 at `5b7e5675c98aa3b660d6f43376006e8ab4528c21` fails x86_64 job120719162620 after the normal product journey with `embedded compositor ELF: Ambiguous`. The actual diagnostics artifact12541842685 (ZIP SHA256 `f8c79acd7ac7ae9bf96164f2cdbc0fa5fff89abb29a03767cfbf9790c270bee1`) retains Root ELF `aa3ac2db80b8ef96254afddcd0a7051491a47667af03b5aeda04ed986a068981`. Running the unchanged extractor against those actual bytes reproduces the refusal. It finds two complete 29256-byte compositor images at offsets16538634 and20470131; both have SHA256 `eb6ef0c507baa3d1117ebc70882c81bba72ca213610288ad0d1f5b93d261d483` and are fully byte-identical.

The collector should establish one unique validated image byte sequence, allowing repeated copies of the exact same image. It must continue to refuse distinct valid images rather than selecting the first candidate or using a serial-supplied hash to resolve ambiguity. This is artifact collection, not a production guest execution or authority change.

Acceptance:
- Reproduce and retain the actual failed-run Root/log/artifact identity and exact candidate equality.
- Accept duplicate identical complete images; reject two distinct structurally valid images. Retain malformed entry/symbol/permissions/extent, missing image and loaded-range refusals.
- Keep actual Root/ISO/build/boot and lifecycle/ACK identity joins intact. Update custody wording to unique image bytes, not unique occurrence.
- Pass focused extractor regressions and the supported preflight gate. Preserve the old failure as negative evidence; artifact reprocessing is not a new QEMU execution.
- Deliver through a reviewed PR with required exact-head Candidate and applicable successful Integration before closing. This does not claim physical display, broader service isolation or parent-issue completion.

The integration shepherd will include the bounded collector repair in the existing reviewed omnibus #6339 so the red dev repair does not add another competing implementation PR.


## Integration repair frontier (2026-10-24 UTC)

The bounded repair is now pushed at `455aaf0a33a5dddf739935003e77b5da2c3788ac` in existing PR #6339. The [immutable23-file packet](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/3282213cb5f25182a927a09a08331f04ccd8f759/docs/audits/evidence/compositor-image-dedup-20261024/455aaf0a3) retains the actual failed diagnostics ZIP/log, duplicate-byte audit, original negative control, five passing corrected extractor tests, all345 supported preflight checks, seven passing YAML cases and independent source review. The repaired extractor reprocesses the actual failed Root to the same29256-byte guest image; the unchanged pure serial parser accepts23 records/four checkpoints/three ACK checkpoints. Actual failed-run ISO bytes are absent, so complete artifact custody is explicitly unverified; no new guest execution is claimed. Fresh [Candidate40049075388](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/actions/runs/40049075388) is queued at455aaf0a3. Required exact-head Candidate, delivery and applicable successful Integration remain outstanding. No issue closure from local proof.


## Current Patchbay entry refusal (2026-10-24 UTC)

The collector unit repair remains scoped and source-bound, but runtime acceptance is blocked before its collector step by #6318.

Candidate40049075388 at source455aaf0a33a5dddf739935003e77b5da2c3788ac (actual preview6975a29c2fe879e3e29d65ae1cbcd3f5f724513b; identical tree89e5e3a75cde6d6edb936cd88771f969c4bb14e5) has a failed x86_64 job120738184105. The normal guest reaches Patchbay, then `Commit` request4496 returns `Fault(WorkExhausted)` during `patchbay-publish` slot2; protected regions revoke and the later harness wait reports `patchbay-action-timeout`. This is the existing ready P0 #6318, rather than evidence that increasing a collector timeout would help. The earlier duplicate-image collector is not reached in this run.

[Immutable current negative packet](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/a30d210e0cccf6caf7fa752556d83703b6fe2a31/docs/audits/evidence/native-application-current-refusal-20261024/6975a29c2) retains the actual10,331,096-byte diagnostics ZIP, raw214,430-byte job log, all35 member hashes, actual Root ELF/build joins and21 checkpoint PNG/pixel hashes. The ISO is identified only by its manifests; original ISO bytes are absent. The precise expensive Commit subphase is not established. No new execution, collector runtime acceptance, full Candidate/Integration or issue closure is claimed.

No additional PR was opened. [Current registry repair, exact positive test and preflight proof](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/d43f2818a0143dcdb81ee319ee11c975a578f5cc/docs/audits/evidence/reviewed-omnibus-lock-registry-20261024/d677b2538); [source-qualified production/Face proof](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/dc6cdb60a0214d50c05b3396b0f862c02e0354d7/docs/audits/evidence/reviewed-omnibus-final-20261024/eacbd8350). ## Actual current omnibus native execution (2026-10-24 UTC)

The x86 job120753952612 in Candidate40054154999 passed. Its actual execution source is merge preview `dacabe7376b1d62c0739377f579bfb332cafa19e`, with exact tree identity to submitted PR head `d677b25383b22ca2911f1ec49936ca7b4a3c86ee`. [Immutable actual product archive, independent audit and requirement reviews](https://github.com/dancxjo/conduit/tree/a3bacc64ad92cac726d0f92021793022332c6d5c/docs/audits/evidence/current-omnibus-native-product-20261024/d677b2538) verify49receiptfiles, actualRoot/ISO/manifest/build/boot joins,23lifecycle snapshots/3ACKs,27PNG pixel/serial-prefix checks and the complete24-step normal journey. The repaired collector emitted the unique-image-bytes receipt. This actualRoot has ONEvalid compositor image; duplicate-copy acceptance remains separately proven by retained actual failedRoot reprocessing and regressions, not invented as a duplicate case in this run.

At03:00 the full Candidate still had foundation, hostedstd and browser running (12success, nofailure). Full Candidate, actual dev delivery and applicable successful Integration remain required before scoped closure. No full phased/cumulative-budget #6318 or physical/broaderparent completion claim.
